questions.prompt: Which card should start the next group?

choices.label: The card with the largest remaining count.
choices.feedback: The smallest remaining card cannot be placed after a missing smaller card, so it must begin a group.

choices.label: The smallest card that still has an unused copy.
choices.feedback: The smallest remaining card cannot be placed after a missing smaller card, so it must begin a group.

questions.prompt: What must be available to complete a group of the required size?

choices.label: One unused copy of every consecutive value starting at that card.
choices.feedback: A group needs consecutive values; a missing required value cannot be replaced by a later card.

choices.label: One card of each different value anywhere in the hand.
